# LuxurLive

> Premium Bespoke Modular Kitchens and Architectural Wardrobes in Kozhikode

LuxurLive is a premium interior design and manufacturing firm specializing in high-end, bespoke modular kitchens and luxury wardrobes. Based in Kozhikode, Kerala, we blend architectural design with precision engineering to create timeless living spaces.

## Products & Services
- **Modular Kitchens**: Sculptural design meets precision engineering.
- **Luxury Wardrobes**: Bespoke storage designed to protect and display with architectural elegance.
- **Consultation**: Private design consultations available at our Kozhikode showroom.
